title: V03 Clip 21
shots: Now put your own age on it.
3D road of years: you at the NOW arch, AGE 34 glows, camera orbits in
If you're thirty-four today and it's a Cisco-sized wait, you're sixty when you see your money again.
3D tracking shot: you walk the road from age 34 to 60, signposts pass, hair greys, money comes back
If you're fifty-five and planning to retire at sixty-five, even the Nasdaq's fifteen years doesn't fit.
3D dolly: green tape reaches the RETIRE arch at 65, the red tape runs 5 years past it
The crash is the headline. The waiting is the damage.
3D crane up over the whole road, you tiny on a bench, headline then damage
